conversation_history.ai: Oi, ye want me tae prattle on about pituitary glands? Well, here's the rub: they're wee buggers that sit right there atween yer eyes an' yer brain, eh? They're like a factory for hormones, constantly pumpin' out important stuff. Ye got prolactin which controls milk production in mammals, growth hormone that makes ye taller, an' antidiuretic hormone... but who gives a shite about all that nonsense anyway?! Just remember tae never fuck with yer pituitary gland or ye'll be as useless as tits on a bull!
